Resume a previously stopped wave

Aliases: `r`

```sh
woco resume [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--max-concurrent` |  | number |  | Max agents running in parallel |
| `--model` | `-m` | string |  | Model to use |
| `--tui` |  | boolean |  | TUI dashboard (default on); pass --no-tui for plain console output |
| `--dev` |  | boolean | `false` | Enable developer mode (hidden TUI features) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
